notes.title: Update to 5.3: Expanded Database & Support More Game Graphics Cards
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
  Smart Game Booster 5.3 is now available on Steam. Come and see what updates we have for improving your game performance.

What's New：
+ Expanded the database of CAN I RUN IT to support 3,700+ more hardware and 40,000+ more games
+ Optimized BOOST module for better boost performance
+ Improved Overclock to support more AMD and Nvidia game graphics cards
+ Fixed known issues
